The '''Doomsday Clock''' is a [[Tools|Tool]] used to measure the current [[Evolution Phases|Evolution Phase]] and the Phase Cooldown.

== ''Obtainment'' ==
{{CraftingTable
|r1_a2=Infected Flesh
|r1_b1=Infected Flesh
|r1_b3=Infected Flesh
|r1_c2=Infected Flesh
|r1_b2=Clock
|r1_output=Doomsday Clock
}}

== ''Usage'' ==
Holding or hovering over the Doomsday Clock in the inventory will show current Evolution Phase of the Dimension they're in with a number from -2 to 10. In the item's tooltip, the current Phase Cooldown (in seconds), when parasites are unable to gain points after progressing in Phase, can be seen.

== ''Trivia'' ==
*The Doomsday Clock was previously known as the '''Bloody Clock''' before 1.10.7.
**Before this, it was known as the '''Dirty Clock'''.
